data.title: Approval of unemployment benefit (Arbeitslosengeld) from 1 January 2027
data.summary: The Agentur für Arbeit Musterlimburg approved unemployment benefit (Arbeitslosengeld) for Bastian Musterquell starting 1 January 2027, for 360 calendar days at a daily rate of €48.71, based on his earnings over the last twelve months at Druckerei Beispiellahn.
data.explanation: This letter confirms you will receive unemployment benefit of €48.71 per day for 360 days starting 1 January 2027. If you have not already registered as unemployed, do so in person or online on your first day without work. If you disagree with the amount or any part of this decision, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) with the Agentur für Arbeit Musterlimburg — the app shows the deadline for this. If you take no action, the decision stands as issued. No payment is required from you for this letter.
